entries.author: chinagt1
entries.title: 《云窗花影》：中式阁楼斜倚的东方古典人像
entries.note: 提示词在作者自己的回复里；原帖未写模型。
entries.prompt:
《云窗花影｜斜倚听风》

大师级东方古典写实人像摄影

一、画幅与摄影风格

4:3横版构图，超写实真人摄影，电影级东方古典美学，真实摄影镜头质感，高清细节，柔和自然光影。

画面具有古典仕女画的诗意与现代高级时尚摄影的精致感。人物肌肤保留真实纹理和细微瑕疵，五官自然协调，不使用CG渲染、塑料磨皮或夸张美颜。

二、人物设定

一位25岁左右的成年东亚女性，容貌清丽柔美，鹅蛋脸，眉眼精致，鼻梁秀挺，唇色自然柔润。

黑色浓密长发梳成蓬松的古典半盘发，发髻点缀少量精致的珍珠与淡金花卉发饰，部分长发自然垂落肩头。

身材高挑匀称，肩颈柔美，腰线纤细，身体曲线自然，符合真实人体解剖结构。

人物神情慵懒、安静，略带朦胧睡意，眼神温柔地望向镜头。

三、服饰设计

身穿一袭淡雾蓝、浅藕粉与月白色交织的东方古典高定薄纱长裙。

服装采用多层轻盈真丝欧根纱与柔软雪纺制作，裙面分布细腻的浅粉色花卉刺绣与淡青色枝叶纹样。

领口采用优雅的斜肩薄纱设计，露出自然肩颈线条，胸前有完整的浅色真丝内衬，外层薄纱柔和覆盖身体。

宽松的透明纱袖自然滑落至上臂，层层裙摆从腰间向右侧延展，铺满卧榻，形成柔和起伏的丝绸褶皱。

布料具有真实的轻薄透光效果，刺绣清晰细腻，不使用密集网格、亮片或金色碎点。

四、人物姿态与动作

女子横向侧卧于古典中式木质软榻上，头部位于画面左侧，身体向右自然延伸。

左手手肘支撑在柔软靠枕上，左手轻轻托住脸颊，头部略微向左倾斜。

右手自然握着一柄精致的圆形刺绣团扇，团扇位于胸前偏下位置，扇面绘有淡粉色牡丹与青绿色叶片。

上半身略微朝向镜头，腰腹自然弯曲，臀部与腿部顺着卧榻向画面右侧舒展。

双腿自然叠放，隐藏在层层薄纱裙摆下，远端可隐约看见自然伸展的脚部轮廓。

所有关节、手指、肩颈、脊柱与腿部姿态必须符合真实人体结构，不出现不合理扭转。

五、场景环境

中国古典高层闺阁，深棕色实木窗框、精致雕花窗棂、传统木质栏杆。

人物躺在铺有米白色软垫与锦缎靠枕的中式罗汉榻上。

画面左下角摆放一盏暖黄色方形木框宫灯，灯光柔和。

左侧窗边摆放一枝盛开的白色玉兰花，花枝自然伸入画面。

两侧悬挂轻薄的白色纱帘，微风吹动纱帘，形成柔和的空间层次。

窗外是远处层叠的中式宫殿屋檐、朦胧群山与云海，夕阳接近山脊，天空呈现柔和的奶油金色。

六、镜头与构图

横版4:3画幅，35mm至50mm全画幅摄影镜头，平视略高机位，中远景人物环境肖像。

人物占据画面中下部约70%的宽度，头部位于左侧三分之一附近，长裙向右自然铺展。

完整保留人物头部、身体、裙摆、卧榻和右侧脚部，不随意裁切。

画面上半部保留古典窗棂、远山、夕阳和纱帘，形成明显的前景、中景与远景层次。

七、光影与色彩

傍晚黄金时刻，自窗外射入柔和的暖金色自然光，照亮人物脸颊、肩颈、发丝与薄纱。

左下角宫灯提供微弱暖色补光，室内木质结构保持自然暗部层次。

整体配色：

雾蓝 × 月白 × 浅藕粉
深胡桃木色 × 香槟金
夕阳暖杏色 × 远山灰青色

明暗过渡自然，保留真实高光与阴影，避免过度锐化及HDR效果。

八、画质与负面提示词

真实成年女性摄影、自然皮肤毛孔、真实头发纤维、准确手指数量、合理肩颈结构、自然脊柱曲线、真实丝绸质感。

禁止：CG感、游戏建模、塑料皮肤、蜡像脸、过度磨皮、畸形五官、错位肩膀、扭曲脊柱、多余手指、畸形手腕、异常腿部比例、断裂脚踝、悬浮身体、布料穿模、密集网格、金色点点、随机闪粉、脏污背景、过度曝光、过度锐化、廉价影楼风格。

最终效果：

如同真实摄影师在古典中式阁楼中拍摄的一张东方美人写真。人物慵懒而优雅，丝纱轻盈，夕阳温暖，具有真实生活气息与古典诗意。

单张独立横版摄影作品，无文字、无水印、无拼图。

entries.title: 沙漠巨景中的东方电影感时装摄影
entries.note: 原帖未写模型。
entries.prompt:
Native 3:4 vertical, ultra-high-resolution photorealistic Eastern cinematic fine-art fashion photography. Monumental desert landscape, extraordinary scale contrast, poetic human presence.

A breathtakingly beautiful 25-year-old adult East Asian woman with a refined oval face, luminous natural skin, delicate almond eyes, slender narrow-shouldered proportions, elegant neck and long dark hair.

She wears flowing smoky-blue and ivory silk couture, with refined draping, a naturally defined waist and a long translucent train trailing gently across the desert sand.

The dominant visual structure is a colossal natural sandstone arch, towering over the woman and occupying most of the upper frame. Its immense curved opening frames a vast pale-blue sky and distant golden dunes.

The woman stands beneath the arch near the lower center of the composition. Her entire figure is visible, deliberately small against the overwhelming scale of the ancient stone.

Emotion and gaze: She has just discovered the extraordinary height of the arch. Her body remains in a natural three-quarter stance, and her head tilts gently upward, following the stone curve above her. Her eyes are clearly directed toward the highest interior point of the arch, expressing genuine wonder and quiet reverence.

Her facial expression is subtle but alive: slightly widened eyes, softly parted lips, an unguarded moment of discovery. Her neck follows a comfortable anatomical line, without exaggerated twisting.

One hand rests naturally beside her body, while the other lightly holds the silk train. Her posture is graceful, grounded and human.

Wide-angle cinematic environmental portrait with restrained perspective, preserving realistic anatomy and the monumental scale of the arch. The woman remains visually recognizable through her luminous face and distinctive blue silk silhouette.

Warm late-afternoon sunlight grazes the sandstone, with delicate reflected illumination on her face. Clean atmospheric depth, translucent silk highlights, warm golden geology contrasting with cool blue fabric and sky, authentic photographic realism, subtle film grain.

One immense architectural form, one small luminous human figure, one moment of awe.

One independent native 3:4 image, no collage, no typography, no watermark.

entries.author: zhangjiajia1314
entries.title: 把照片变成 90 年代 SNK 街机格斗游戏像素画
entries.note: 需配参考图；原帖未写模型。
entries.prompt:
将我上传的参考图片转换为 90年代日本 SNK Neo Geo 街机格斗游戏风格的16-bit像素艺术画面。

严格保留原图的主体人物数量、人物外貌特征、发型、服装、姿势、动作、表情、配饰，以及场景构图、背景建筑和重要物体。不要随意改变人物身份特征、服装设计或原始画面内容。

视觉风格要求：
经典1990年代日式街机格斗游戏画风。
高质量16-bit像素美术，具有经典 Neo Geo 游戏质感。
清晰、粗犷、有层次的像素轮廓。
采用块状像素阴影、逐级明暗过渡和细腻抖动（Dithering）。
高饱和度配色，鲜明的光影对比。
人物采用经典格斗游戏角色的像素化造型，保留自然的人体比例和清晰的面部特征。
背景转换为精致的2D街机游戏场景，保留原图中的空间关系和环境细节。
具有复古街机游戏截图的氛围，同时保证画面精致、清晰。

重要限制：
不要变成普通8-bit马赛克风格，不要使用现代3D卡通渲染，不要变成扁平插画，不要改变原图人物数量和动作，不要随意添加或删除物体，不要模糊像素细节，不要裁切主体。
最终效果：仿佛原照片中的场景和人物被完整制作成了一款1990年代 Neo Geo 街机格斗游戏的实机画面。

保持原始图片的宽高比例。

entries.author: CandyTravelight
entries.title: 20 岁东方女生写实人像：皮肤质感对比
entries.note: 第 4 张为左右并排对比：左 GPT Image 2，右 Gemini。
entries.prompt:
【主体设定】20岁成年东方女性，身高175cm，沙漏型身材，上身曲线饱满优美，腰线纤细、臀部圆润上翘，双腿纤细笔直，自然比例。青春感，看起来就是20岁的大二学生，脸颊饱满有胶原蛋白，皮肤紧致有光泽，脸部线条圆润柔和，苹果肌，眼睛清澈明亮笑起来弯弯，眉形自然平直，唇色水润淡粉，妆容极淡。黑色及肩半扎发配酒红色蝴蝶结，有碎发。樱桃红U领修身罗纹针织长袖上衣，露出锁骨和肩颈线；黑色百褶短裙到大腿中部；肤色薄款哑光丝袜；薄荷绿漆皮厚底玛丽珍。不穿外套，不披外套。
【场景动作】高级餐厅暖光卡座旁，她手拿一杯气泡水（杯壁有水汽）被逗笑的瞬间，不死盯镜头；双手自然放松，五根手指完整清晰、比例正常。
【视觉风格】iPhone 随手抓拍。
【构图镜头】2:3 竖版，膝上中景，平视，人物在三分线，35mm，f/1.8，轻微胶片颗粒。
【光影色彩】暖色吊灯柔光加一圈轮廓光，脸部亮部和阴影有层次，肤色自然通透；主色樱桃红和黑，跳色薄荷绿。
【材质细节】真实毛孔和细小绒毛，自然高光，脸颊淡淡红晕，左右脸轻微不对称，眼睛有反光，唇上有细纹，眉毛一根根清楚；罗纹针织有肌理；发丝细密有碎发；杯壁水汽。
【负面约束】塑料皮肤、娃娃脸、网红脸、过度磨皮、美颜滤镜、浓妆、3D渲染感、五官变形、手部变形、多余或缺失手指、手指粘连、成熟感、轻熟风、显老、法令纹、外套、披在肩上的外套、文字、水印、拼图。

entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily photorealistic, breathtaking cinematic fashion portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult woman in her mid-twenties, posing gracefully on a dramatic rocky coastline surrounded by crashing ocean waves. The atmosphere evokes untamed femininity, effortless confidence, windswept beauty, and the sophisticated elegance of luxury coastal swimwear photography. The final image must resemble an authentic professional photograph of a real living woman, never CGI, illustration, or digital artwork.

Woman and Facial Features: A stunning woman with luminous warm golden-olive skin, softly sculpted cheekbones, a refined straight nose, naturally full rose-nude lips, and mesmerizing almond-shaped hazel-brown eyes framed by long eyelashes. Her makeup features softly smoky bronze eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, subtle terracotta blush, and naturally tinted lips. Her expression is serene, confident, and deeply peaceful, with her eyes gently closed and chin raised toward the ocean breeze. Preserve realistic skin pores, subtle facial asymmetry, and authentic human anatomy.

Hair: Her extraordinarily long, thick, glossy dark chestnut-brown hair cascades down her back in magnificent, naturally tousled waves. Strong coastal winds lift individual strands dramatically around her face and shoulders, revealing subtle golden-brown highlights. Her hair appears slightly damp, naturally voluminous, and effortlessly beautiful.

Outfit and Accessories: She wears an elegant black designer two-piece swimsuit featuring a beautifully structured, fully lined triangle-style top with slender shoulder straps and a secure, softly curved neckline. Matching black side-tie swim bottoms feature delicate adjustable ribbons and refined minimalist tailoring. An oversized lightweight black linen shirt drapes loosely around her shoulders, with its long sleeves billowing gently in the sea breeze. Minimal gold jewellery includes small hoop earrings, a delicate necklace with a sculptural pendant, and fine golden bracelets.

Pose and Body Language: Capture her standing gracefully on a smooth coastal rock, her torso facing slightly toward the camera. Both arms extend elegantly above her head, with her wrists gently crossed and fingers naturally relaxed. Her back curves subtly as she stretches toward the sky, while her head tilts backward and eyes remain peacefully closed. Her posture conveys freedom, relaxation, and natural confidence.

Setting and Atmosphere: A magnificent rugged coastline featuring dark volcanic rocks, powerful foaming ocean waves, distant dramatic cliffs, and a softly overcast pale-grey sky. Fine ocean mist drifts through the air, while the turbulent sea creates beautiful natural movement behind her.

Lighting and Cinematography: Beautiful diffused coastal daylight illuminates her face, shoulders, flowing hair, and black swimwear. Gentle directional shadows sculpt her features, while soft silver reflections shimmer across the crashing waves. Muted charcoal, deep ocean grey, warm bronze, and natural ivory tones dominate the cinematic palette.

Composition and Quality: Vertical 9:16 cinematic editorial portrait, medium-full framing from head to upper thighs, eye-level three-quarter perspective. Professional full-frame photography, 85mm portrait lens, realistic skin texture, individually defined windswept hair strands, authentic fabric movement, natural ocean reflections, subtle analogue film grain, and breathtaking 8K photographic realism.

Essential Requirement: A genuine luxury coastal swimwear photograph featuring a real adult woman on an authentic rocky beach. No oil painting, illustration, CGI, plastic skin, distorted anatomy, exaggerated proportions, text, logos, or watermark.

entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily photorealistic, breathtaking cinematic overhead portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult woman in her mid-twenties, reclining peacefully among floating lotus leaves in a secluded, tranquil garden pond. The atmosphere evokes ethereal femininity, timeless romance, natural serenity, and the dreamlike elegance of luxury fine-art fashion photography. The final image must resemble an authentic photograph of a real living woman, never CGI, illustration, or digital artwork.

Woman and Facial Features: A stunning woman with luminous warm ivory-olive skin, an elegantly sculpted oval face, delicate cheekbones, a refined straight nose, naturally full rose-pink lips, and expressive almond-shaped dark hazel eyes framed by long eyelashes. Her makeup features subtle champagne eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, soft peach blush, and naturally tinted rosy lips. Her expression is serene, dreamy, and deeply peaceful, with her eyes gently closed and lips naturally relaxed. Preserve realistic skin pores, subtle freckles, natural facial asymmetry, and authentic human anatomy.

Hair: Her extraordinarily long, thick, glossy dark espresso-brown hair spreads freely around her head in magnificent, naturally tousled waves. Abundant loose curls rest gently across the water and surrounding lotus leaves, forming beautiful organic patterns. Individual strands display realistic texture, subtle moisture, and delicate natural highlights.

Outfit and Fabric: She wears an exquisite flowing ivory-white Grecian-inspired couture gown crafted from luxurious silk chiffon and lightweight organza. The elegant, fully lined bodice features softly gathered overlapping fabric, graceful shoulder straps, and delicate diagonal pleating across the torso. The magnificent floor-length skirt spreads outward in flowing, cloudlike folds, creating a striking contrast against the surrounding deep-green lotus leaves. The fabric appears naturally lightweight, with realistic silk textures and delicate folds.

Pose and Body Language: Capture her reclining gracefully on her back upon a shallow, partially submerged stone platform surrounded by lotus leaves. Her head tilts gently sideways, eyes peacefully closed, while both arms extend naturally beside her body. Her flowing gown spreads around her figure, and her long dark hair fans outward across the surrounding water. Her posture feels weightless, spontaneous, and beautifully serene.

Setting and Atmosphere: A secluded botanical garden pond filled with enormous overlapping sage-green lotus leaves, delicate lily pads, scattered pale ivory water lilies, and naturally weathered foliage. Tiny patches of dark water appear between the leaves, reflecting the surrounding greenery. Soft botanical textures create an intimate, enchanting environment.

Lighting and Cinematography: Beautiful diffused morning sunlight filters through surrounding trees, illuminating her face, dark flowing hair, and luminous ivory gown. Gentle shadows create natural depth across the lotus leaves, while subtle reflections shimmer on the water. Muted sage, olive green, warm ivory, and soft botanical gold dominate the sophisticated colour palette.

Composition and Quality: Vertical 9:16 cinematic editorial photograph, dramatic directly overhead camera perspective, full-body composition with the woman positioned diagonally among the lotus leaves. Professional full-frame photography, 50mm lens, realistic skin texture, individually defined hair strands, authentic silk physics, natural botanical details, subtle film grain, and breathtaking 8K photographic realism.

Essential Requirement: A genuine luxury fine-art fashion photograph featuring a real adult woman in a real botanical pond.
